errorCodes.meaning: The credential's proof did not verify against the issuer key resolved from its DID. The credential is not stored. A consumer MUST NOT retry unchanged.

The maintainer does not implement the declared `format`. Distinguished from a verification failure so a consumer can tell "this maintainer cannot hold this credential" from "this credential is not valid".

schema.description: Verify and store a W3C verifiable credential. Exactly one of `credential` or `credentialBase64` must be present.

contextId.description: Context to hold the credential in. Absent, the consumer's own.

credential.description: The verifiable credential as a JSON object.

credentialBase64.description: The credential base64url-encoded without padding, for formats whose canonical form is not JSON.

format.description: Credential format, when not evident from the body. An unimplemented format is refused, not stored.

id.description: Local handle to store under. Absent, derived from the credential's own id. A handle, not a description — see Data carried.
